fee_notes: Primary market: 6.5% royalty of gross revenue; Secondary market: $2,000/month fixed royalty. Primary market marketing fee $1,200/month (can increase to 3% GR); Secondary $1,400/month (can increase to $1,600/month). Local marketing required 3-6% GR annually. Marketing cooperatives 3-6% GR as members determine.
raw_excerpt: Royalty - Primary Market: 6.5% of Gross Revenue; Secondary Market: $2,000 per month. Marketing Fee - Primary Market: $1,200 per month; Secondary Market: $1,400 per month. Upon notice to you, we may increase the Marketing Fee up to 3% of Gross Revenue for a Primary Market and up to $1,600 per month for a Secondary Market.
